name: @finapp/m22-approval
description: M22 — finance approval workflow (maker-checker + Segregation of Duties). The single lifecycle choke point for controlled finance actions (e.g. journal posting from m21): one aggregate, explicit valid transitions, transition reason codes, service-layer authorization, optimistic concurrency, idempotency, append-only status/decision history, audit, events, workflow + notification hooks, deterministic escalation, controlled cancellation + resubmission, terminal-state protection. It NEVER approves on behalf of a human, NEVER lets one identity both make and check a controlled action (SoD, DB CHECK), and NEVER builds a second workflow/timer/notification engine — it reuses m06 (workflow/SLA/timers + the ONE outbox) and m08 (notifications) through opaque references. It owns no journals (m21), no ledger/posting (m21/m23), no chart of accounts/periods (m19); subject/workflow/timer/notification/document refs are OPAQUE ids.
